fee.text: Sato Hub fee: 0.15% of the USDC you swap (up to 0.0075 USDC), paid in USDC to Sato Hub's Jupiter referral token account FMEXEnUt2fxKkZewdWq5PKebLw4vs1ddyayJjKap4LGo inside this same transaction. It comes out of the amount you swap; nothing is added on top.

notes: No freeze authority is set on this mint.
No mint authority is set on this mint (no more can be created).

This Token-2022 mint charges a transfer fee of 1% (100 bps; at most 1000000000000000 base units per transfer) on every transfer of it, so a buy delivers less than the swap output and a sale sends less than it appears to. The fee can be changed by 5KXDF6QnqhBj72hDtJNkkpFaQVUfbFXNybMsp3DiK6tD.
The mint carries its own metadata (name, symbol, link), which is whatever its creator wrote.
